review_mode: two-pass source review by one analyst plus deterministic consistency checks; not independent double annotation
default_review_notes: Pass A checked formula boundary, title, materials, quantities, roles and use context against the preserved witness span. Pass B checked normalized composition, linked-family neighbours and release eligibility.
release_policy: Only revision-addressable Wikisource witnesses are included in v0.1. CText-derived candidates remain internal until scan and redistribution checks are complete.
